name: narrowing-through-a-published-declaration
description: A library whose consumer set the fixture declares complete. A published type that the consumer reaches through the package's exported declarations without naming it, as the type of a property, an array element or a map value of what an exported function returns, a class that type extends, the type of a parameter, of an exported constant, the element of an exported result type alias, a property of an unexported class an exported function returns, the inferred result of an exported function, a class or an interface an unexported type an exported function returns extends, the element of an unexported alias an exported function returns, the value of an index signature of a returned interface, the result of a namespace's exported function, the type a guard or an assertion function narrows to, the constraint or the default of an exported function's type parameter, a branch of a conditional type or the template of a mapped type an exported function returns, an alias the compiler reads as the type it aliases, an interface a returned class implements, or the constraint of a returned class's type parameter, is not reported as a candidate for unexporting, because the consumer holds values of the type. A type only a private property names, and one only the package names, are reported.
